learningAssumptions: Author-selected dependency: practice planning a box to its goal before tracking completion of multiple boxes.
The fixed bot does not learn between units. Campaign stages describe content exposure and runtime objective checks; human learning and mastery are unverified.
The 0.25 per-decision action replacement probability is an arbitrary controlled synthetic execution model, not an estimate of human error.
Targets and content are selected on the same 20 seeds. Independent holdout seeds are reported separately without post-hoc retuning.
